status: The hub accepted these pre-candidate solver settings on 2026-11-01. No NZ convergence measurement supports them yet: G8-x measures convergence and peak memory, and a later change needs a reviewed edit before any candidate counts.

reasons.epochs: Allow 3000 fixed Adam epochs, matching the existing US build budget and exceeding the UK local budget of 2000; no NZ trajectory yet establishes convergence.
reasons.learning_rate: Start Adam at 0.15, the existing UK and US operational setting; no NZ candidate supplies evidence yet.
reasons.mass: Let calibration fit independently published target margins after CREATE scales the design population to June 2025 ERP; free mass avoids an additional conservation constraint.
reasons.max_weight_ratio: Limit each final household weight to five times its design weight; G8-x tests NZ feasibility.
reasons.weight_anchor: Anchor the solver cap to design weights because calibrate.ordered_adam@1 requires that anchor whenever a cap exists.

cap_disclosure: The solver limits each row relative to its design weight. MC15 independently tests final weights after source-household aggregation and compares their maximum with their positive median; a design-weight cap of 5 does not establish MC15's ratio threshold of 5.
execution_requirements: The operator must measure memory and capacity before a candidate and account for two CREATE executions on a cold run: the inventory probe and graph execution.
The operator must retain the local graph store and plan resume before execution. The graph, solver settings and checkpoint identities govern replay.
The graph passes only epochs, learning_rate, mass, max_weight_ratio and weight_anchor to calibrate.ordered_adam@1. The export declaration supplies its own time period.
